lines.zh: 这部新的恐怖片怎么样？看起来超吓人的！

lines.en: I really want to watch a scary horror movie!
lines.zh: 我特别想看一部吓人的恐怖片！

beats.goal: React to disagreement and seek middle ground

lines.en: You dislike horror? What should we pick instead?
lines.zh: 你不喜欢恐怖片呀？那我们换选什么呢？

lines.en: Okay, no horror. Maybe a funny comedy instead?
lines.zh: 好吧，不看恐怖片。要不看部搞笑喜剧？

beats.goal: Propose specific movie to watch together

lines.en: How about that new detective comedy with Kowalski?
lines.zh: 那部科瓦尔斯基主演的侦探喜剧片怎么样？

lines.en: Shall we watch that travel documentary together?
lines.zh: 我们一起看那部旅行纪录片好不好？

beats.goal: Wrap up film selection and start movie

lines.en: Great, I'm pressing play! Is the popcorn ready?
lines.zh: 太好了，我按播放键啦！爆米花准备好了吗？

lines.en: Perfect choice! Sit back and enjoy the show.
lines.zh: 绝佳选择！坐好，准备欣赏电影吧。

example.en: So, what kind of movies do you like?
example.zh: 那么，你喜欢什么类型的电影？

example.en: I enjoy comedies because they help me relax.
example.zh: 我喜欢喜剧，因为它们能帮我放松。

example.en: Look at this new horror film. Let's watch it!
example.zh: 看看这部新恐怖片。我们看它吧！

example.en: I can't stand horror movies.
example.zh: 我真的受不了恐怖片。

example.en: Come on, horror is so thrilling!
example.zh: 哎呀，恐怖片多刺激啊！

example.en: You're right, but maybe something lighter tonight?
example.zh: 你说得对，但今晚看点轻松的怎么样？

example.en: How about that funny Polish road trip comedy?
example.zh: 那部搞笑的波兰公路喜剧片怎么样？

example.en: Sounds good, let's watch that one!
example.zh: 听起来不错，就看那部吧！

example.en: Great, I'm pressing play! Is the popcorn ready?
example.zh: 太好了，我按播放键啦！爆米花准备好了吗？

example.en: Yes, popcorn is ready. Turn off the lights!
example.zh: 准备好了，爆米花好啦。关灯吧！

repair.en: Did you want action or comedy?
repair.zh: 你是想看动作片还是喜剧片？

repair.en: Sorry, what title did you just suggest?
repair.zh: 抱歉，你刚才建议的是哪部片名？

beats.goal: Invite neighbor over for dinner

lines.en: Would you like to come over to our place for dinner?
lines.zh: 平安夜你愿意来我们家吃晚饭吗？

lines.en: Please join my family for Christmas Eve dinner!
lines.zh: 请来和我家人一起吃圣诞夜晚餐吧！

beats.goal: Share traditional Polish Christmas Eve food

lines.en: Do you know what people traditionally eat on Wigilia?
lines.zh: 你知道波兰人在平安夜传统上吃些什么吗？

lines.en: We eat twelve dishes like beetroot soup and carp.
lines.zh: 我们吃十二道菜，比如红菜汤和鲤鱼。

beats.goal: Ask neighbor to bring fitting dish

lines.en: Could you bring a traditional dish from your home?
lines.zh: 你能带一道你家乡的传统菜来吗？

lines.en: Can you bring something to share with everyone?
lines.zh: 你能带一点特色美食来和大家分享吗？

beats.goal: Ask how holidays are celebrated in China

lines.en: How do you celebrate holidays back home in China?
lines.zh: 在你的家乡中国，你们是怎么庆祝节日的？

lines.en: Tell me about winter holiday traditions back home.
lines.zh: 给我讲讲你们家乡冬季节日的传统吧。

beats.goal: Wrap up Christmas Eve invitation

lines.en: We'll expect you then! Merry Christmas!
lines.zh: 那我们到时恭候你的到来！圣诞快乐！

lines.en: See you on Christmas Eve! Merry Christmas to you!
lines.zh: 平安夜见！祝你圣诞快乐！

example.en: Hello! Would you like to come over for dinner?
example.zh: 你好！你愿意来我们家吃晚饭吗？

example.en: Thank you so much! I'd love to come.
example.zh: 太感谢了！我很乐意来。

example.en: We would be delighted to have you.
example.zh: 你能来我们会非常高兴的。

example.en: What do people traditionally eat on Christmas Eve?
example.zh: 大家在平安夜传统上都吃些什么？

example.en: We eat fish and pierogi. Could you bring a dish?
example.zh: 我们吃鱼肉和饺子。你能带一道菜来吗？

example.en: Back home in China, we celebrate with dumplings.
example.zh: 在我们中国老家，我们吃饺子庆祝节日。

example.en: Dumplings sound delicious! Everyone will love them.
example.zh: 饺子听起来太好吃了！大家肯定都会喜欢的。

example.en: Merry Christmas to you and your family!
example.zh: 祝您和您的全家圣诞快乐！

example.en: We'll expect you then! Merry Christmas!
example.zh: 那我们到时恭候你的到来！圣诞快乐！

example.en: See you on Christmas Eve, Marek!
example.zh: 平安夜见，马雷克先生！

reactions.zh: 我老伴一定会很喜欢的。

repair.en: Pardon, what kind of food did you say?
repair.zh: 不好意思，你刚才说的是什么食物？

repair.en: Will you arrive at five or at six?
repair.zh: 你打算五点到还是六点到？

beats.goal: Challenge colleague on why Kraków is better

lines.en: Go on, what makes Kraków any better?
lines.zh: 说说看，克拉科夫到底哪点比华沙好？

lines.en: Warsaw has everything! Why do you prefer Kraków?
lines.zh: 华沙应有尽有！你为什么更喜欢克拉科夫？

beats.goal: Defend Warsaw opportunities and ask opinion

lines.en: Warsaw has many more career opportunities, right?
lines.zh: 华沙的职业机会多得多，对吧？

lines.en: What do you think about the job market?
lines.zh: 你对两地的就业市场怎么看？

beats.goal: Ask where colleague wants to live

lines.en: Where would you like to live in ten years?
lines.zh: 十年后你想住在哪里？

lines.en: In ten years, will you still live here?
lines.zh: 十年之后，你还会住在这里吗？

beats.goal: Find shared ground between the two cities

lines.en: Is there something good about both cities?
lines.zh: 这两座城市有什么共同的优点吗？

lines.en: Can we agree both have great food and culture?
lines.zh: 我们能否一致同意它们都有美食和好文化？

beats.goal: Wrap up friendly debate on draw

lines.en: All right, let's call it a draw! Back to work.
lines.zh: 行啦，就算平局吧！回工位干活啦。

lines.en: Fair enough, a draw it is! Let's get lunch.
lines.zh: 好吧，就算打个平手！咱们吃午饭去。

example.en: Come on! Go on, what makes Kraków any better?
example.zh: 来吧！说说看，克拉科夫到底哪点更好？

example.en: Kraków is smaller, but it's much prettier.
example.zh: 克拉科夫虽小，但漂亮得多。

example.en: Maybe so, but Warsaw has better career opportunities.
example.zh: 也许吧，但华沙有更好的工作机会。

example.en: There are more job opportunities in Warsaw, but life is calmer here.
example.zh: 华沙的工作机会确实更多，但这里的生活更从容。

example.en: Where would you like to live in ten years?
example.zh: 十年之后你想在哪里生活？

example.en: In ten years, I'd like to live near the mountains.
example.zh: 十年后，我想住在靠近山脉的地方。

example.en: Can we agree both cities have amazing restaurants?
example.zh: 我们能不能一致认为两座城市都有很棒的餐厅？

example.en: I agree with you on that, both are great.
example.zh: 这一点我同意你的看法，两座城市都很棒。

example.en: All right, let's call it a draw! Back to work.
example.zh: 行啦，就算平局吧！回工位干活啦。

example.en: Deal! Time to get back to work.
example.zh: 成交！该回去工作了。

reactions.zh: 我之前倒没想到这一点。

repair.en: Did you mean Kraków or Warsaw?
repair.zh: 你是指克拉科夫还是华沙？

repair.en: Sorry, what was that second point again?
repair.zh: 抱歉，你的第二个论点是什么来着？

beats.goal: Ask friend about future projects

lines.en: What will you be working on?
lines.zh: 你接下来打算做什么呢？

lines.en: What are your main plans for next year?
lines.zh: 你明年的主要计划是什么？

beats.goal: Ask what they would do with more money

lines.en: What would you do with more time or money?
lines.zh: 如果你有更多的时间或金钱，你会做什么？

lines.en: If you had endless money, what would you buy?
lines.zh: 如果你有用不完的钱，你会买什么？

beats.goal: Ask why learner decided to study Polish

lines.en: By the way, why did you decide to learn Polish?
lines.zh: 顺便问问，你当初为什么决定学波兰语呀？

lines.en: Polish is so hard! Why are you learning it?
lines.zh: 波兰语这么难！你为什么在学它呢？

beats.goal: Invite friend to ask about future dreams

lines.en: Do you want to know about my dream job?
lines.zh: 你想知道我的梦想工作是什么吗？

lines.en: Ask me what my own biggest dream is!
lines.zh: 快问问我最大的梦想是什么！

beats.goal: Wrap up late-night chat before sleeping

lines.en: It's getting late—time for bed. Good night!
lines.zh: 很晚了——该睡啦。晚安！

lines.en: I'm so sleepy. Let's sleep now. Good night!
lines.zh: 我好困呀。我们现在睡吧。晚安！

example.en: Hey, what will you be working on next year?
example.zh: 嗨，你明年打算做什么？

example.en: Next year, I'm planning to travel around Europe.
example.zh: 明年我计划环游欧洲。

example.en: Wow! What would you do with even more time?
example.zh: 哇！如果你有更多的时间，你会做什么？

example.en: If I had more time, I would travel more.
example.zh: 如果我有更多时间，我会去更多地方旅行。

example.en: Nice! Why did you decide to learn Polish?
example.zh: 真好！你当初为什么决定学波兰语？

example.en: I'm learning Polish because I live here.
example.zh: 我学波兰语是因为我住在这里。

example.en: That makes sense. It's tough but useful.
example.zh: 很有道理。虽然难但很有用。

example.en: What would you do in my shoes? What is your dream?
example.zh: 换作你在我的处境你会怎么做？你的梦想又是什么？

example.en: It's getting late—time for bed. Good night!
example.zh: 很晚了——该睡啦。晚安！

example.en: Good night, Kasia! Sweet dreams.
example.zh: 晚安卡夏！祝你美梦。

reactions.zh: 那听起来像梦一样美好！

repair.en: Could you say that goal once more?
repair.zh: 你能把那个目标再说一遍吗？

repair.en: Did you say travel or study next year?
repair.zh: 你刚才说是明年去旅行还是学习？
